text: The decomposition of the regular representation over $\mathbb{C}$ yields which dimension formula, where $n_i=\dim V_i$ ranges over the irreducibles?
explanation: Each irreducible $V_i$ appears in $\mathbb{C}[G]$ with multiplicity $n_i=\dim V_i$, so $|G|=\dim\mathbb{C}[G]=\sum_i n_i\cdot n_i=\sum_i n_i^2$. The unsquared sum and the product are simply the wrong combination, and $r$ counts conjugacy classes, not $|G|$.
